services.desc: Come relax and enjoy the offerings of this spectacular lake of almost 1000 miles of shoreline! The Crest is a 22 foot, 115 horsepower pontoon that holds the lesser of 12 passengers or 1692 lbs and has a Bimini top for shade. Ask us about delivery to your vacation rental home or campsite. Often, we can deliver the boat by water to your location making the process hassle free; occasionally a delivery fee is required depending on distance. No towing (waterskiing, towables, etc.) or night operations are authorized. The boat is available for rent if you have a dock or appropriate place to park overnight. Due at time of booking is a $250 REFUNDABLE security deposit required for each
